title: Write and read a text file
description: Use with open(...) to write any short message into a text file, then open it again and print the contents.
solution:
with open("note.txt", "w") as file:
    file.write("Hello file")
with open("note.txt", "r") as file:
    print(file.read())

title: Append to a file
description: Use with open(...) to create a file, append more text to it, then read and print the contents.
solution:
with open("log.txt", "w") as file:
    file.write("A")
with open("log.txt", "a") as file:
    file.write("B")
with open("log.txt", "r") as file:
    print(file.read())

title: Read file lines
description: Write at least two lines to a text file, read the file, and print its lines.
solution:
with open("items.txt", "w") as file:
    file.write("pen\nbook")
with open("items.txt", "r") as file:
    for line in file:
        print(line.strip())

title: Count file characters
description: Write any text into a file, read it, use len() to count its characters, and print the count.
solution:
with open("data.txt", "w") as file:
    file.write("CodeBolt")
with open("data.txt", "r") as file:
    text = file.read()
print(len(text))

title: Write multiple lines
description: Create a text file with at least two lines, read it, and print the contents.
solution:
lines = ["one", "two", "three"]
with open("list.txt", "w") as file:
    file.write("\n".join(lines))
with open("list.txt", "r") as file:
    print(file.read())
